fields.label: Does the main building exterior have a light-colored paint for eight to ten feet from the bottom edge to preclude intruders from hiding in shadows?
Are buildings clear of shrubbery where an intruder could hide?
Are trees located far enough away to prevent an intruder from using either height or branches as a means of entry?
Are second and third floor windows locked/barred?
Are first and second floor windows alarmed?
Are air conditioning units in lower windows properly secured so they cannot be removed from the exterior?
Are perimeter areas of building(s) well lighted and free of trash buildup?
Are ladders, long boards, and the like, near the building or stored in a locked area?
Are areas away from entrances well lighted?
Are outbuildings secured when not in use?
Are outbuildings patrolled during non-duty hours by the guard force?
What is the frequency of guard patrols?
Are guard patrols at random or in a set pattern?
Are perimeter doors and windows locked and/or alarmed or fixed shut?
Are doors made so they open outward or inward according to building code?
Are door pins, for outward opening doors, non-removable or welded in place?
Can outbuildings be accessed without the guard force being aware of it, or in a manner that precludes casual observation of such access?
Are outbuildings protected by a local alarm system or tied into the main system?
Are plans in effect or contemplated to install monitor controls for outbuildings?
Are door locks rekeyed at least once every other year?
Are keys to outbuildings limited to essential personnel only?
How many keys to outbuildings have been lost or are unaccounted for?
Can outbuildings be accessed from another area, unobserved by a patrolling guard (enclosures against the building, and so forth)?
Are solid core doors used on all exterior entrances/exits?
Are paneled or hollow core doors lined with a metal sheet?
Are glass doors also alarmed or are they located at entrances that are guarded or under observation at all times, especially during nonworking hours?
Are unguarded glass doors protected by steel bars or wire mesh, or are they tied to the alarm system?
Do all glass doors have a double-keyed cylinder instead of an interior thumb-turn?
Are overhead doors locked either by electric power or slide bolts?
Are slide bolts mounted on interior rather than exterior sides?
If mounted exteriorly, are pick-resistant locks employed?
Do all exterior doors have a pick-resistant lock cylinder?
Do all exterior doors have a deadbolt feature?
Are all exterior doors locked and checked at the close of business each day?
